rename.from: FormHelper input fields with disabled lables are duplicated...
rename.to: 3.x FormHelper input fields with disabled lables are duplicated...

body:
seems to be a duplicate of #4972.
Did you try to update the latest version of CakePHP ?
yes, the version is up to date

I confirm this bug : (cake updated 2minutes ago)
![screenshot_10](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/8210023/4789443/428f125e-5dc5-11e4-927f-5e58a16fbebb.png)
Looks like the problem [is here](https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/blob/3.0/src/View/Helper/FormHelper.php#L1182) - label false effectively becomes "use the input again as a label".
Are you using custom templates for your form helper or extending the helper?

@lorenzo Yes, but when i comment it, it's still the same.
I think it's related to https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/commit/5727368622971dfc824b0292cca9a3caaf4ae4a0
I can look at this, as it _was_ working locally for me the last time I fixed it. Are there any other inputs beyond normal text inputs that are problematic?
I'm a toolshed, I fixed it but never pushed the changes :cry:

issue.title: Fix issue with label=false.
